high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "royal_tail_puppies_chennai__" located in Chennai, India. The post features two German Shepherd puppies being held by someone whose hands are visible but not their face. The puppies appear to be very young, with soft fur and small paws. They are positioned close together, with one puppy slightly leaning against the other. The background is a bright yellow wall, which contrasts with the dark and light brown fur of the puppies.
